en: Dependent on a wholesome state associated with consciousness, there arises a state not associated with consciousness and not wholesome by way of root condition. Under root condition: one [formula] … pe … under non-disappearance condition: one.

Dependent on an unwholesome state associated with consciousness, there arises a state not associated with consciousness and not unwholesome by way of root condition. Under root condition: one … pe … under non-disappearance condition: one. (The indeterminate root has only three conditions.)
